```python
import openpyxl
from openpyxl.styles import Font, PatternFill, Alignment, Border, Side, numbers
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter
from openpyxl.chart import BarChart, Reference
from datetime import datetime

wb = openpyxl.Workbook()

# ── Styles ──────────────────────────────────────────────
HEADER_FILL   = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="1F4E79")
SUBHEADER_FILL = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="2E75B6")
INCOME_FILL   = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="C6EFCE")
EXPENSE_FILL  = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFC7CE")
TOTAL_FILL    = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFEB9C")
ALT_ROW       = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="DDEBF7")
WHITE         = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="FFFFFF")
GRAY_FILL     = PatternFill("solid", fgColor="F2F2F2")

THIN = Side(style='thin', color='BFBFBF')
MEDIUM = Side(style='medium', color='2E75B6')
border_thin  = Border(left=THIN, right=THIN, top=THIN, bottom=THIN)
border_medium = Border(left=THIN, right=THIN, top=MEDIUM, bottom=MEDIUM)

header_font  = Font(name='Calibri', size=12, bold=True, color='FFFFFF')
title_font   = Font(name='Calibri', size=18, bold=True, color='1F4E79')
subtitle_font = Font(name='Calibri', size=11, italic=True, color='595959')
num_font     = Font(name='Calibri', size=11)
bold_font    = Font(name='Calibri', size=11, bold=True)
pct_font     = Font(name='Calibri', size=10, color='2E75B6')

center = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center', wrap_text=True)
left   = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='center')
right  = Alignment(horizontal='right',  vertical='center')
wrap   = Alignment(horizontal='left',   vertical='center', wrap_text=True)

def style_header(ws, row, cols):
    for c in range(1, cols + 1):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=c)
        cell.fill = HEADER_FILL
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = center
        cell.border = border_medium

def style_cell(cell, fmt=None, bold=False, fill=None, align=center):
    if fill:
        cell.fill = fill
    cell.font = bold_font if bold else num_font
    cell.alignment = align
    cell.border = border_thin
    if fmt:
        cell.number_format = fmt

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 1 – Dashboard
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Dashboard"
ws.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

# Column widths
ws.column_dimensions['A'].width = 28
ws.column_dimensions['B'].width = 18
ws.column_dimensions['C'].width = 18
ws.column_dimensions['D'].width = 22

# Title
ws.merge_cells('A1:D1')
t = ws['A1']
t.value = "💰 Personal Budget Tracker"
t.font = title_font
t.alignment = center
ws.row_dimensions[1].height = 40

ws.merge_cells('A2:D2')
s = ws['A2']
s.value = f"Tracking Period: {datetime.now().strftime('%B %Y')}  |  Stay on top of your finances!"
s.font = subtitle_font
s.alignment = center

# ── Summary Cards (rows 4-9) ────────────────────────────
summary_labels = [
    ("Total Income",      "Income!B15",  "$#,##0.00",       INCOME_FILL),
    ("Total Expenses",    "Expenses!B34", "$#,##0.00",       EXPENSE_FILL),
    ("Net Balance",       "='Income!B15'-'Expenses!B34'", "$#,##0.00", TOTAL_FILL),
    ("Savings Rate",      "='Income!B15'-'Expenses!B34'/'Income!B15", "0.0%", pct_font),
    ("Fixed Expenses",    "Expenses!B35", "$#,##0.00",       GRAY_FILL),
    ("Variable Expenses", "='Expenses!B34'-'Expenses!B35'", "$#,##0.00", GRAY_FILL),
]
for i, (label, formula, fmt, fill) in enumerate(summary_labels):
    r = i + 4
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value = label
    style_cell(ws.cell(row=r, column=1), bold=True, fill=fill, align=left)
    ws.merge_cells(f'A{r}:B{r}')
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=3)
    c.value = f"='{formula}'" if '=' not in str(formula) else formula
    c.number_format = fmt
    style_cell(c, bold=True, fill=fill, align=right)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value = "%" if "Rate" in label else ""
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).number_format = "0%"

# ── Category Breakdown Section ──────────────────────────
ws.cell(row=11, column=1).value = "📊 Expense Breakdown by Category"
ws.cell(row=11, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=13, bold=True, color='1F4E79')
ws.merge_cells('A11:D11')

cats = [
    "Housing", "Transportation", "Food & Dining", "Utilities",
    "Healthcare", "Entertainment", "Shopping", "Education",
    "Savings", "Debt Payments", "Other"
]
for i, cat in enumerate(cats):
    r = 12 + i
    ws.cell(row=r, column=1).value = cat
    style_cell(ws.cell(row=r, column=1), fill=ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE, align=left)
    c = ws.cell(row=r, column=2)
    c.value = f"=SUMIF(Expenses!$D$10:$D$32,\"{cat}\",Expenses!$B$10:$B$32)"
    c.number_format = "$#,##0.00"
    style_cell(c, fill=ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE, align=right)
    d = ws.cell(row=r, column=3)
    d.value = f"=IF(B15>0,B{r}/B15,0)"
    d.number_format = "0.0%"
    style_cell(d, fill=ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE, align=right)
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).value = f"=B{r}"
    ws.cell(row=r, column=4).number_format = "$#,##0.00"
    style_cell(ws.cell(row=r, column=4), fill=ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE, align=right)

# Add chart at the bottom
chart = BarChart()
chart.type = "col"
chart.style = 10
chart.title = "Expenses by Category"
chart.y_axis.title = "Amount ($)"
chart.x_axis.title = "Category"
chart.width = 14
chart.height = 10

data = Reference(ws, min_col=2, min_row=11, max_row=22, max_col=2)
cats_ref = Reference(ws, min_col=1, min_row=12, max_row=22)
chart.add_data(data, titles_from_data=True)
chart.set_categories(cats_ref)
chart.shape = 4
ws.add_chart(chart, "F4")

# Sparkline-style visual bar in column E
for i, cat in enumerate(cats):
    r = 12 + i
    e = ws.cell(row=r, column=5)
    e.value = f'=IF(B15>0,REPT("█",ROUND(B{r}/B15*30,0)),0)'
    e.font = Font(name='Consolas', size=8, color='2E75B6')
    e.alignment = left

ws.column_dimensions['E'].width = 16

print("Dashboard sheet done")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 2 – Income
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws2 = wb.create_sheet("Income")
ws2.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

ws2.column_dimensions['A'].width = 20
ws2.column_dimensions['B'].width = 18
ws2.column_dimensions['C'].width = 20
ws2.column_dimensions['D'].width = 16

# Title
ws2.merge_cells('A1:D1')
ws2['A1'].value = "📈 Income Sources"
ws2['A1'].font = title_font
ws2['A1'].alignment = center

# Headers
headers = ["Source", "Amount ($)", "Frequency", "Notes"]
for i, h in enumerate(headers, 1):
    cell = ws2.cell(row=3, column=i)
    cell.value = h
style_header(ws2, 3, 4)

# Income rows with pre-filled examples + formulas
incomes = [
    ("Salary / Wage",           "",       "Monthly", "Main job"),
    ("Freelance / Side Gig",    "",       "Monthly", ""),
    ("Investment Returns",      "",       "Quarterly",""),
    ("Rental Income",           "",       "Monthly", ""),
    ("Gifts / Bonus",           "",       "Irregular",""),
    ("Other Income",            "",       "",        ""),
]
for i, (src, amt, freq, notes) in enumerate(incomes):
    r = 4 + i
    fill = ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE
    ws2.cell(row=r, column=1).value = src
    style_cell(ws2.cell(row=r, column=1), fill=fill, align=left)
    c = ws2.cell(row=r, column=2)
    c.value = amt
    c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    style_cell(c, fill=fill, align=right)
    ws2.cell(row=r, column=3).value = freq
    style_cell(ws2.cell(row=r, column=3), fill=fill, align=center)
    ws2.cell(row=r, column=4).value = notes
    style_cell(ws2.cell(row=r, column=4), fill=fill, align=left)

# Total row
r = 10
ws2.merge_cells(f'A{r}:B{r}')
ws2.cell(row=r, column=1).value = "TOTAL INCOME"
style_cell(ws2.cell(row=r, column=1), bold=True, fill=INCOME_FILL, align=right)
c = ws2.cell(row=r, column=2)
c.value = "=SUM(B4:B9)"
c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
style_cell(c, bold=True, fill=INCOME_FILL, align=right)
ws2.merge_cells(f'C{r}:D{r}')
ws2.cell(row=r, column=3).value = "=B10"  # total reference placeholder
style_cell(ws2.cell(row=r, column=3), bold=True, fill=INCOME_FILL, align=center)

# Monthly breakdown section
ws2.cell(row=13, column=1).value = "📅 Monthly Income Detail"
ws2.cell(row=13, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=12, bold=True, color='1F4E79')
ws2.merge_cells('A13:D13')

months = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"]
ws2.cell(row=14, column=1).value = "Source"
style_header(ws2, 14, 13)
for j, m in enumerate(months):
    col = j + 2
    ws2.cell(row=14, column=col).value = m
    ws2.cell(row=14, column=col).fill = SUBHEADER_FILL
    ws2.cell(row=14, column=col).font = header_font
    ws2.cell(row=14, column=col).alignment = center
    ws2.cell(row=14, column=col).border = border_medium

# Income data rows for monthly
for i, src in enumerate(["Salary","Freelance","Investments","Rent","Other"]):
    r = 15 + i
    fill = ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE
    ws2.cell(row=r, column=1).value = src
    style_cell(ws2.cell(row=r, column=1), fill=fill, align=left)
    for j in range(12):
        col = j + 2
        c = ws2.cell(row=r, column=col)
        c.value = ""
        c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
        style_cell(c, fill=fill, align=right)
    # Total column
    tc = ws2.cell(row=r, column=14)
    col_letter = get_column_letter(14)
    tc.value = f"=SUM({col_letter}15:{col_letter}26)"
    tc.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    style_cell(tc, bold=True, fill=fill, align=right)

ws2.column_dimensions['N'].width = 16

print("Income sheet done")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 3 – Expenses
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws3 = wb.create_sheet("Expenses")
ws3.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

ws3.column_dimensions['A'].width = 22
ws3.column_dimensions['B'].width = 16
ws3.column_dimensions['C'].width = 22
ws3.column_dimensions['D'].width = 18
ws3.column_dimensions['E'].width = 16
ws3.column_dimensions['F'].width = 14

# Title
ws3.merge_cells('A1:F1')
ws3['A1'].value = "💸 Expense Tracker"
ws3['A1'].font = title_font
ws3['A1'].alignment = center

# Headers row 3
exp_headers = ["Date", "Amount ($)", "Description", "Category", "Payment Method", "Recurring?"]
for i, h in enumerate(exp_headers, 1):
    cell = ws3.cell(row=3, column=i)
    cell.value = h
style_header(ws3, 3, 6)

# Pre-filled expense categories (10 sample rows + blank rows)
expenses = [
    ("2025-01-01", 1200.00, "Rent Payment",            "Housing",     "Bank Transfer", "Yes"),
    ("2025-01-05",  150.00, "Electric Bill",            "Utilities",   "Credit Card",   "Yes"),
    ("2025-01-07",   85.00, "Internet Service",         "Utilities",   "Credit Card",   "Yes"),
    ("2025-01-10",  420.00, "Grocery Shopping",         "Food & Dining","Debit Card",    "No"),
    ("2025-01-12",   60.00, "Gas / Fuel",               "Transportation","Cash",        "No"),
    ("2025-01-15",  120.00, "Streaming & Subscriptions","Entertainment","Credit Card",   "Yes"),
    ("2025-01-18",   45.00, "Coffee & Snacks",          "Food & Dining","Credit Card",   "No"),
    ("2025-01-20",  200.00, "Gym Membership",           "Entertainment","Bank Transfer", "Yes"),
    ("2025-01-22",   75.00, "Phone Bill",               "Utilities",   "Credit Card",   "Yes"),
    ("2025-01-25",  300.00, "Clothing Purchase",        "Shopping",    "Debit Card",    "No"),
]
for i, (dt, amt, desc, cat, pm, rec) in enumerate(expenses):
    r = 4 + i
    fill = ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=1).value = dt
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=1), fill=fill, align=center)
    c = ws3.cell(row=r, column=2)
    c.value = amt
    c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    style_cell(c, fill=fill, align=right)
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=3).value = desc
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=3), fill=fill, align=left)
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=4).value = cat
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=4), fill=fill, align=center)
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=5).value = pm
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=5), fill=fill, align=center)
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=6).value = rec
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=6), fill=fill, align=center)

# Blank rows for user input (rows 14-32)
for r in range(14, 33):
    fill = ALT_ROW if (r - 14) % 2 == 0 else WHITE
    for c in range(1, 7):
        cell = ws3.cell(row=r, column=c)
        cell.border = border_thin
        cell.fill = fill
        cell.alignment = center
        if c == 2:
            cell.number_format = '$#,##0.00'

# Category Totals section
ws3.cell(row=35, column=1).value = "📊 Category Totals"
ws3.cell(row=35, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=13, bold=True, color='1F4E79')
ws3.merge_cells('A35:C35')

cat_headers = ["Category", "Total ($)", "% of Budget"]
for i, h in enumerate(cat_headers, 1):
    cell = ws3.cell(row=36, column=i)
    cell.value = h
    cell.fill = SUBHEADER_FILL
    cell.font = header_font
    cell.alignment = center
    cell.border = border_medium

categories = [
    "Housing", "Transportation", "Food & Dining", "Utilities",
    "Healthcare", "Entertainment", "Shopping", "Education",
    "Savings", "Debt Payments", "Other"
]
for i, cat in enumerate(categories):
    r = 37 + i
    fill = ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=1).value = cat
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=1), fill=fill, align=left)
    c = ws3.cell(row=r, column=2)
    c.value = f"=SUMIF(D10:D32,A{r},B10:B32)"
    c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    style_cell(c, fill=fill, align=right)
    d = ws3.cell(row=r, column=3)
    d.value = f"=IF($B$34>0,B{r}/$B$34,0)"
    d.number_format = '0.0%'
    style_cell(d, fill=fill, align=right)

# Total row
r = 48
ws3.merge_cells(f'A{r}:B{r}')
ws3.cell(row=r, column=1).value = "TOTAL EXPENSES"
style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=1), bold=True, fill=EXPENSE_FILL, align=right)
c = ws3.cell(row=r, column=2)
c.value = "=SUM(B37:B47)"
c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
style_cell(c, bold=True, fill=EXPENSE_FILL, align=right)

# Fixed vs Variable breakdown
ws3.cell(row=50, column=1).value = "📁 Expense Classification"
ws3.cell(row=50, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=12, bold=True, color='1F4E79')

fixed_label = ws3.cell(row=51, column=1)
fixed_label.value = "Fixed Expenses:"
style_cell(fixed_label, bold=True, fill=GRAY_FILL, align=left)
fixed_val = ws3.cell(row=51, column=2)
fixed_val.value = "=B37+B39+B40+B46"  # Housing + Utilities + Education + Savings as fixed
fixed_val.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
style_cell(fixed_val, bold=True, fill=GRAY_FILL, align=right)

var_label = ws3.cell(row=52, column=1)
var_label.value = "Variable Expenses:"
style_cell(var_label, bold=True, fill=GRAY_FILL, align=left)
var_val = ws3.cell(row=52, column=2)
var_val.value = "=B34-B51"
var_val.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
style_cell(var_val, bold=True, fill=GRAY_FILL, align=right)

# Payment method summary
ws3.cell(row=54, column=1).value = "💳 Payment Method Summary"
ws3.cell(row=54, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=12, bold=True, color='1F4E79')

pm_methods = ["Credit Card", "Debit Card", "Cash", "Bank Transfer", "Other"]
for i, pm in enumerate(pm_methods):
    r = 55 + i
    fill = ALT_ROW if i % 2 == 0 else WHITE
    ws3.cell(row=r, column=1).value = pm
    style_cell(ws3.cell(row=r, column=1), fill=fill, align=left)
    c = ws3.cell(row=r, column=2)
    c.value = f"=COUNTIF(E10:E32,\"{pm}\")"
    style_cell(c, fill=fill, align=center)
    d = ws3.cell(row=r, column=3)
    d.value = f"=SUMIF(E10:E32,\"{pm}\",B10:B32)"
    d.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
    style_cell(d, fill=fill, align=right)

# Spending alert
ws3.cell(row=62, column=1).value = "⚠️ Spend Alert Threshold"
ws3.cell(row=62, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=11, bold=True, color='C00000')
ws3.merge_cells('A62:C62')
ws3.cell(row=63, column=1).value = "If monthly spending exceeds this %, highlight in red:"
ws3.cell(row=63, column=3).value = 0.80
ws3.cell(row=63, column=3).number_format = '0%'
style_cell(ws3.cell(row=63, column=3), align=right)
ws3.cell(row=63, column=4).value = "=IF(B34>B63*Income!B10,\"⚠️ OVER BUDGET!\",\"✅ On Track\")"
ws3.cell(row=63, column=4).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=11, bold=True, color='C00000')
ws3.cell(row=63, column=4).alignment = left

for col in ['E','F']:
    ws3.column_dimensions[col].width = 16

print("Expenses sheet done")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# SHEET 4 – Monthly Overview
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
ws4 = wb.create_sheet("Monthly Overview")
ws4.sheet_view.showGridLines = False

ws4.column_dimensions['A'].width = 22
for j in range(2, 14):
    ws4.column_dimensions[get_column_letter(j)].width = 14
ws4.column_dimensions['N'].width = 16

ws4.merge_cells('A1:N1')
ws4['A1'].value = "📅 Monthly Budget Overview"
ws4['A1'].font = title_font
ws4['A1'].alignment = center

# Month headers
months_full = ["January","February","March","April","May","June","July","August","September","October","November","December"]
ws4.cell(row=3, column=1).value = "Item"
style_header(ws4, 3, 13)
for j, m in enumerate(months_full):
    col = j + 2
    ws4.cell(row=3, column=col).value = m[:3]
    ws4.cell(row=3, column=col).fill = SUBHEADER_FILL
    ws4.cell(row=3, column=col).font = header_font
    ws4.cell(row=3, column=col).alignment = center
    ws4.cell(row=3, column=col).border = border_medium

# Income row
row_idx = 4
items = [
    ("Total Income", "INCOME", None),
    ("Fixed Expenses", "EXPENSE", "A5:A6"),
    ("Variable Expenses", "EXPENSE", None),
    ("Net Savings", "CALC", "=B4-B5-B6"),
    ("Savings Rate", "PCT", "=IF(B4>0,B7/B4,0)"),
]
for label, typ, formula in items:
    r = row_idx
    fill = INCOME_FILL if typ == "INCOME" else (EXPENSE_FILL if typ == "EXPENSE" else GRAY_FILL)
    ws4.cell(row=r, column=1).value = label
    style_cell(ws4.cell(row=r, column=1), bold=(label=="Net Savings"), fill=fill, align=left)
    if formula:
        if isinstance(formula, str):
            ws4.merge_cells(f'A{r}:L{r}')
            c = ws4.cell(row=r, column=1)
            c.value = f"={formula}"
            c.number_format = '$#,##0.00'
        else:
            for col in range(2, 14):
                cell = ws4.cell(row=r, column=col)
                cell.value = formula if 'PCT' not in str(formula) else formula
                cell.number_format = '$#,##0.00' if 'PCT' not in label else '0.0%'
                style_cell(cell, fill=fill, align=right)
    else:
        for col in range(2, 14):
            cell = ws4.cell(row=r, column=col)
            cell.value = ""
            cell.number_format = '$#,##0.00' if 'Rate' not in label else '0.0%'
            style_cell(cell, fill=fill, align=right)
    row_idx += 1

# Annual totals
r = row_idx + 1
ws4.merge_cells(f'A{r}:N{r}')
ws4.cell(row=r, column=1).value = "📊 Annual Summary"
ws4.cell(row=r, column=1).font = Font(name='Calibri', size=13, bold=True, color='1F4E79')

r += 2
annual_items = [
    ("Annual Income",              "0.0%",       True),
    ("Annual Expenses",            "0.0%",       True),
    ("Annual Net Savings",         "0.0%",       True),
    ("Average Monthly Savings",    "0.0%",       False),
    ("Projects Met (≥10% savings)","Text",        False),
]
for label, nf, bold in annual_items:
    rr = r
    ws4.cell(row=rr, column=1).value = label
    style_cell(ws4.cell(row=rr, column=1), bold=bold, fill=GRAY_FILL, align=left)
    c = ws4.cell(row=rr, column=2)
    if nf == "Text":
        c.value = f'=IF(COUNTIF(B7:L7,">=0.1")>=6,"✅ Yes","❌ No")'
        c.number_format = '@'
    else:
        c.value = f'=SUM(B7:L7)' if "Annual" in label else f'=AVERAGE(B7:L7)'
        c.number_format = '$#,##0.00' if "Savings" in label or "Income" in label or "Expenses" in label else nf
    style_cell(c, bold=bold, fill=GRAY_FILL, align=right)
    ws4.merge_cells(f'B{rr}:L{rr}')
```
